stages.title: Before anyone deploys the site again
stages.blurb: Two sessions publish this site from the files on disk. Make sure the next deploy keeps the newest pages, and check the pages nobody has opened since they went live.

steps.title: Sync the "ZYT Skill" session before its next deploy
steps.detail: Its message address stopped working, so it does not know that deploy e8d30d52 added /nct/step-11-plan/ (and that the dashboard now shows this runbook and the Steps 1–3 page). It must deploy from the files on disk that include these changes. A deploy from an older copy removes them.

steps.title: Click through the NCT SOP page
steps.detail: Went live with deploy 1e0c0d7c, now built from customer-intake-sop/sop.json. Check "Show my flow", the ?role=<id> links, the full-screen chain view with the role rail, and the fix list.

steps.title: Click through the JWA SRF full-chain SOP page
steps.detail: Went live with deploy 1e0c0d7c. Check the "verified against code" line and the role view.

stages.title: Steps 1–3 · enquiry record, credit and duplicates, contact nomination
stages.blurb: Three worktrees in three waves. Planned 2026-09-14; no code yet.

steps.title: Create wt-step1, wt-step2, wt-step3 and install
steps.detail: Update feat/new-layout, add the three worktrees from origin/feat/new-layout, run bun install in each, and start claude in each. The plans are not in git: copy C:\Project\ZYT-Task\plans\ to C:/nct-plans/.

steps.title: Wave 1: step 03 all phases · step 02 Phase 1 · step 01 all phases
steps.detail: Run in parallel, one session per worktree. Only step 01 migrates (0066, a nullable column) — db:migrate in wt-step1 only. Browser checks one worktree at a time: every app wants :3101 and :3000.

steps.title: Merge step 03 → step 02 Phase 1 → step 01
steps.detail: In that order, each rebased on what merged ahead of it and through the pre-PR checklist (read check-types output, not its exit code). Migration 0066 lands with step 01.

steps.title: Wave 2: step 02 Phase 2 (duplicate refusal), then merge
steps.detail: Rebase wt-step2 first so step 01's Add company dialog change sits underneath. Duplicate-company refusal, near-match list and Name collisions filter.

steps.title: Gate: run the production duplicate-company count
steps.detail: Migration 0067_company_name_ci_unique fails partway through the deploy unless company.nameCollisionCount = 0. Dev read 0 on 2026-09-14; production has not been checked. Read-only probe nct-layout/e2e/out/_walk/probe-step2.ts with I_KNOW_THIS_IS_PRODUCTION=1 (the owner override in apps/server/dev-db-guard.ts). If the count is not 0, clear the duplicates first (Task 3.0, reviewed before it runs).

steps.title: Wave 3: step 02 Phase 3 (case-insensitive index 0067), then merge
steps.detail: Only when the production count is 0. 0067 must follow 0066 in the journal with no gap, or take the next free number at merge.

steps.title: Tick the fixed findings and remove the worktrees
steps.detail: Tick nct-channels, nct-credit, the step 02 duplicates finding and the step 03 primary-contact finding in Findings. Remove each worktree only once merged and git status is clean.

stages.title: Steps 4–10 · quote → approval → send → decision
stages.blurb: Seven plans in four waves; can run alongside Steps 1–3 (shared migration journal only). All 33 decisions settled 2026-09-15.

steps.title: One-time setup; create Wave 1 worktrees
steps.detail: Create worktrees for a wave when that wave starts, so each branches from the latest base. Wave 1: wt-step04, wt-step08, wt-step05. Keep wt-step04 after it merges — Wave 3 reuses it for Task F.1.

steps.title: Wave 1: step 04 all · step 08 Phases 1+4 · step 05 all
steps.detail: Merge order 04 → 08 P1+P4 → 05. Only 04 migrates.

steps.title: Gates before merging 04 and 05: production counts
steps.detail: Step 04: fee_template audit_status counts and the 30-day in-use count (step 04 §7) — cards in use get submitted for approval the day before the migration applies. Step 05 Phase 2: any role policy denying quotationDate / quotationStaff (step 05 §7).

steps.title: Wave 2: step 08 Phases 2+3 · step 06 all
steps.detail: Starts when all of Wave 1 is merged. Merge order 08 P2+P3 → 06. No migrations.

steps.title: After step 08 Phase 3 merges: run the drift count
steps.detail: Task 3.5's script: quotations stamped approved without a review, or unlocked. Decide row by row (D5-A). Code does not wait for it.

steps.title: Wave 3: step 04 Task F.1 · step 07 all · step 09 all
steps.detail: Starts when all of Wave 2 is merged. Merge order F.1 → 07 → 09. Only 09 migrates.

steps.title: Before releasing step 07: rate-card clash probe
steps.detail: The §8 probe for same-date rate-card clashes and unit-spelling variants. Hand the list to Pricing to supersede or clean. No data change (D4-A).

steps.title: Add the "use Correct decision" hint to step 10's Wave 4 prompt
steps.detail: When rebasing, step 10 adds the "use Correct decision" hint to the X5 refusal message (correctionPath: true). This goes in the prompt you write, not in step 10's plan file.

steps.title: Wave 4: step 10 all phases
steps.detail: Starts when all of Wave 3 is merged. Step 10 migrates.

steps.title: Before merging step 10: deploy-time re-seed for existing orgs
steps.detail: D6-A. Must run before any browser check against an existing org.

steps.title: Remove merged worktrees
steps.detail: Only once a branch is merged and git status is clean. Remove wt-step04 only after Task F.1 has merged too.

stages.title: Step 11 · Convert won quote
stages.blurb: All decisions taken: D1 option B, option A for D2–D9. Phase 1 closes X5 (a Lost quotation can become a job).

steps.title: Run the read-only production probes P1–P5
steps.detail: They measure the existing damage; none blocks Phase 1 code. P1: orders made from Lost quotations — hand the list to sales/operations under D9 (report only, each order checked by hand). P2: conversions made before any decision was recorded. P3: quotations with more than one order. P4: orders whose lines carry two different numbers. P5: fee lines with a minimum charge.

steps.title: Tell the step 12 and step 14 planners where the job-number allocator moves
steps.detail: D5: it moves to packages/api/src/modules/collective-order/insert-order.ts.

steps.title: Phase 1 (X5) in wt-step11 — needs Wilfred's go-ahead
steps.detail: Wave 1, merged after step 05. A Lost quotation cannot become a job, and a job is minted once. Touches convertToOrder's first 70 lines, one JSX condition and one test file.

steps.title: Prove the conversion lock on the dev database
steps.detail: Two simultaneous Convert presses must create one order. The PGlite unit tests cannot prove this.

steps.title: Phase 2: a converted job arrives numbered
steps.detail: After Phase 1 and step 10 are merged (step 10's Task 2.1 edits the same handler region).

steps.title: Phase 3: receivable lines keep quantity and unit price
steps.detail: After Phase 2, and after steps 06 and 07 (they change quantities and floors). Re-run probe P5 at merge.

steps.title: Fix the flow seed for step 11
steps.detail: tracker/seed/flow-nct.json:155 reads /order//edit (missing order id). The step 10 card's "Lost → the chain ends here" (:143) only becomes true once Phase 1 merges.

stages.title: Anytime
stages.blurb: No deadline, nothing waits on these.

steps.title: Authorise the Cloudflare and Neon MCP servers
steps.detail: In claude.ai connector settings, or with /mcp in an interactive claude session. They are unavailable to Claude until then.

steps.title: Set NCT's real App URL
steps.detail: The SOP page's App URL box defaults to http://localhost:3101/, so its screen links point at the visitor's own machine. Set the real address once there is one.

steps.title: Give JWA its tasks
steps.detail: JWA has no to-do tasks in tracker/seed and no Convex seed mutation, so its dashboard is empty.

stages.title: Steps 12–15 · job number, intake, job shape, order approval
stages.blurb: Waves 6–11 of the steps 11–15 runbook. All 53 decisions settled 2026-09-17; sessions implement the chosen option. Wave 5 (step 11 Phases 2–3) is stage D.

steps.title: Commit or set aside the uncommitted e2e changes
steps.detail: The main nct-layout checkout has uncommitted edits under e2e/ (seed-cli.ts among them). Every browser walk uses that seeder and worktrees will not see the edits. Commit them or put them somewhere safe before Wave 6 — no session stashes or resets (crosscheck X16).

steps.title: Wave 6: step 12 Phase 1 (+ optional Phase 3), then step 13 Phase 2
steps.detail: wt-step12 runs the Assign number row lock and re-stamp; wt-step13-p2 runs the reopen verb and intake rules. Merge 12 P1 → 13 P2, rebasing and re-locating symbols at HEAD. Needs Wave 5 (stage D) merged.

steps.title: Gate: run 13-P8 and insert the reopen permission row
steps.detail: Before step 13 Phase 2 deploys: run probe 13-P8, then the reviewed permission_node INSERT for collectiveOrder.reopen (dev before the proof, production after deploy and before any grant). Step 13 D12-A.

steps.title: Step 12 Phase 2: rewrite the SOP text and republish
steps.detail: Only after Wave 5 is deployed. SOP step 12 becomes "Check the job number" (step 12 D6-A), with matching fixes in customer-intake-sop/sop.json and tracker/seed/flow-nct.json, then a site redeploy.

steps.title: Gate: run 15-P13, 15-P6 and 15-P10 before step 15 Task 1.2
steps.detail: They size the post-approval freeze on containers, cargo and appendages (D3-A), the fee-grid carve-out (D2-B) and assignNumber after approval (D16-B). If a result contradicts the settled choice, stop and re-plan.

steps.title: Wave 7: step 15 Phase 1 — an order under review cannot be edited
steps.detail: wt-step15: the under-review freeze on all seven order writers plus the FOR UPDATE lock in collective_order.exists (crosscheck X6), with collective-order.under-review.test.ts and the real-Postgres concurrency test. API before web.

steps.title: Wave 8: step 15 Phase 2 — delete the legacy review verbs
steps.detail: collectiveOrder.review and reviewBatch go, separation of duties goes on, and the permission node stays registered without isEndpoint. Gates 15-P4 before Task 2.1 and 15-P1/P12 before Task 2.2 (Wilfred).

steps.title: Gate: run 14-P3, 14-P4 and 14-P5 before step 14 Task 1.1
steps.detail: They show how many existing orders would fail the readiness rule and whether the required-field set is right (step 14 D2-A, D8-A). Operations also confirms the field list.

steps.title: Wave 9: step 14 Phase 1 — an incomplete order cannot be submitted
steps.detail: wt-step14: readiness enforced at submit through step 07's assertPublishable hook (crosscheck X9). Merges after step 15 Phase 1, and before step 15 Phase 3 because both edit seed/operations.ts (X12).

steps.title: Wave 10: step 15 Phase 3 and step 14 Phase 2, in parallel
steps.detail: Step 15 Phase 3 adds the approval gates (create_lading on B/L create and re-link, expense_entry on cost lines); step 14 Phase 2 shows what is missing on the edit form. Gate 15-P1 before Task 3.4, and 15-P2/P5/P11 before the release note.

steps.title: Wave 11: step 14 Phase 3 — order status becomes a list
steps.detail: A milestone list per trade, with old values left as they are. Gate 14-P1 first, and operations confirms the non-sea chains. Server and web ship in one release.

steps.title: Name an owner for the accepted gaps (X13), or accept them
steps.detail: Nobody refuses submitting an archived, unreceived or rejected order; nobody keeps rejected orders out of the trade ledgers; the SOP text for steps 14–15 has no owner. Accepted on 2026-09-17 as known gaps.

stages.title: Steps 16–19 · bill of lading → release → B/L document → demurrage clock
stages.blurb: Waves 12–16 of the steps 16–19 runbook, in four worktrees. Every decision settled 2026-09-21; Wave 12 starts when all of Wave 11 is merged.

steps.title: One-time setup; create each wave's worktrees
steps.detail: Update feat/new-layout, then create a wave's worktrees when that wave starts: wt-step16, wt-step18, wt-step19 at Wave 12 (kept through Wave 14), wt-step17 at Wave 15 (kept through Wave 16). Run bun install in each and start claude there.

steps.title: Confirm the settled decisions (16–19, X17–X27)
steps.detail: Settled 2026-09-21: the recommended option of every decision in the four plans and every cross-plan item X17–X27, with no exception; step 17 D2 is B (per X17) and 17 D8 is superseded by 16 D1 (per X18). Tick to confirm; sessions implement the Chosen option and do not re-open it.

steps.title: Gate: run 16-P1, P2, P3 before step 16 Task 1.1; 16-P4, P6 before Task 1.2
steps.detail: Read-only production probes, run with the owner's override before the code is written. 16-P1, 16-P2 and 16-P3 gate 16 Task 1.1 (D1, D2, D3); 16-P4 and 16-P6 gate 16 Task 1.2 (D4, D5, D7). A result that contradicts a settled decision stops that task for a re-plan.

steps.detail: Tasks 1.1–1.5: under X17 this phase owns the lading.update under-review freeze, the FOR UPDATE load and the lading.exists lock. Starts when all of Wave 11 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged. Gated by 16-P1, P2, P3, P4 and P6.

steps.title: Wave 12: step 18 Phase 1 in wt-step18
steps.detail: Tasks 1.1, 1.3 and 1.5 only (D3-A / X23): the order and B/L picker and document.unlink; do not edit the order documents payload. Starts when all of Wave 11 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged.

steps.title: Wave 12: step 19 Phase 1 in wt-step19
steps.detail: Tasks 1.1–1.4: blJob.sourceStatus and one missing-login notice on the board, record page and gate-out card (D7-B). Starts when all of Wave 11 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged.

steps.title: Gate: run 16-P5, 16-P7, 19-P2, P3, P6 before Wave 13's tasks
steps.detail: 16-P5 gates 16 Task 2.1 (D6); 16-P7 gates 16 Task 2.4 (D9); 19-P2, 19-P3 and 19-P6 gate 19 Task 2.1 (D2, D4, D3; drop Task 2.1 if 19-P3 shows no difference). A contradiction stops that task for a re-plan.

steps.title: Wave 13: step 16 Phase 2 in wt-step16 (rebase first)
steps.detail: Tasks 2.1–2.4: the write-side order resolver, and Bills of lading (n) / Raise bill of lading on the order record page. Server before web. Starts when Wave 12 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged. Gated by 16-P5 and 16-P7.

steps.title: Wave 13: step 18 Phase 2 in wt-step18 (rebase first)
steps.detail: Tasks 2.1–2.3: re-type a needs_review document at review and show validation errors under their fields (D5-A, D6-A). Web only for deploy purposes. Starts when Wave 12 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged.

steps.title: Wave 13: step 19 Phase 2 in wt-step19 (rebase first)
steps.detail: Tasks 2.1–2.4: step 19 owns the order documents payload reshape (X23). Its server deploys only after step 18 Phase 1 is deployed. Starts when Wave 12 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged. Gated by 19-P2, P3 and P6.

steps.title: Gate: run 18-P1 and 18-P2 before step 18 Task 3.1
steps.detail: 18-P1 (open duplicate bl_jobs per org and BL number) and 18-P2 (approved mbl_hbl documents with no job) gate 18 Task 3.1 (D7, D8); 18-P1's count goes in the release note. A contradiction stops the task for a re-plan.

steps.title: Wave 14: step 16 Phase 3 in wt-step16 (rebase first)
steps.detail: Tasks 3.1–3.2: OCR errors shown per field, with an Apply anyway tick (D11-A, D12-A). Starts when Wave 13 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged.

steps.title: Wave 14: step 18 Phase 3 in wt-step18 (rebase first)
steps.detail: Tasks 3.1–3.3: the transaction and per-org advisory lock in blIntakeHook, and the approval_hook_failed notice (D7-A, D8-A); no migration. API only. Starts when Wave 13 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged. Gated by 18-P1 and 18-P2.

steps.title: Wave 14: step 19 Phase 3 in wt-step19 (rebase first)
steps.detail: Tasks 3.1–3.3: blJob.get returns the order-scoped matching orders by BL number (D6-A). Server first. Starts when Wave 13 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged.

steps.title: Gate: run 17-P1 and 17-P2 before step 17 Task 1.3
steps.detail: 17-P1 (the lading flow per org) and 17-P2 (bills by latest submission, a re-run of 16-P4's first query) gate 17 Task 1.3 and the Phase 1 deploy notice. A contradiction stops the task for a re-plan.

steps.title: Wave 15: step 17 Phase 1 in wt-step17
steps.detail: The Review menu on the bill page, lading.get.underReview with the notice and Save disabled, and the deleteAttachment freeze; no second guard or lock (X17). API before web. Starts when Wave 14 is merged (all of step 16 is in); ticked when its PR is merged. Gated by 17-P1 and 17-P2.

steps.title: Gate: run 17-P4 before step 17 Task 2.1; 17-P6 before Task 2.3
steps.detail: 17-P4 gates 17 Task 2.1 (D6): if the desk routinely checks out held bills, stop and re-plan. 17-P6 gates 17 Task 2.3 (D8, now 16 D1 under X18).

steps.title: Wave 16: step 17 Phase 2 in wt-step17 (rebase first)
steps.detail: One locked transaction per state move, the attachment list lock, the Hold reason, the D6 precondition and the drift report. API first is cleanest. Starts when Wave 15 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged. Gated by 17-P4 and 17-P6.

steps.title: Remove merged worktrees
steps.detail: Only once a branch is merged and git status in its worktree is clean. Keep wt-step16, wt-step18 and wt-step19 through Wave 14, and wt-step17 through Wave 16.

steps.title: Where the plans and the crosscheck disagree
steps.detail: Most rows are resolved by the 2026-09-21 settlements and kept for the record; the last column says which reading this runbook uses where a small gap remains. None re-opens a settled decision.

stages.title: Steps 20–26 · fees → bills → invoice → settlement
stages.blurb: Waves 17–21 of the steps 20–26 runbook, in seven worktrees; Wave 21 is optional. Every decision settled 2026-09-21; Wave 17 starts when all of Wave 16 is merged.

steps.title: One-time setup; create each wave's worktrees
steps.detail: Update feat/new-layout, then create a wave's worktrees when that wave starts: wt-step20, wt-step22, wt-step23, wt-step25 and wt-step26 at Wave 17; wt-step21 and wt-step24 at Wave 18. Run bun install in each and start claude there.

steps.title: Confirm the settled decisions (20–26, X28–X40)
steps.detail: Settled 2026-09-21: the recommended option of every per-plan decision and the recommended reading of every cross-plan item X28–X40, with no exception. Where an X-item overrides a plan's own recommendation, the X-item wins. Tick to confirm; sessions implement the Chosen option and do not re-open it.

steps.title: Gate: run 22-P1, 22-P4, 22-P5, 26-P3 and 25-P1, P3, P4, P6, P7 before Wave 17's tasks
steps.detail: 22-P1 gates 22 Task 1.1; 22-P4 and 22-P5 gate 22 Task 1.2 (D3); 26-P3 gates 26 Task 1.2 (D3; re-plan to B on reconciliation use); 25-P1, P3, P4, P6 and P7 gate 25 Phase 1. A contradiction stops that task for a re-plan.

steps.title: Wave 17: step 20 Phase 1 in wt-step20
steps.detail: Tasks 1.1–1.6: keep the delete set named removable (loaded and not kept), which step 21 Phase 2 builds on (X29). Server first. Starts when all of Wave 16 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged. Ask for 20-P3 before the release note.

steps.title: Wave 17: step 22 Phase 1 in wt-step22
steps.detail: Tasks 1.1–1.4: under X28 this phase owns the whole createBill body, with the locked read ordered by (created_at, id) (X30). API only. Starts when all of Wave 16 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged. Gated by 22-P1, 22-P4 and 22-P5.

steps.title: Wave 17: step 23 Phase 1 in wt-step23
steps.detail: Tasks 1.1–1.5: export the shared underReviewGate(resourceType) (X34). API only; announce "request withdrawal before changing a bill". Starts when all of Wave 16 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged. Ask for 23-P2 and 23-P4 before the release note.

steps.title: Wave 17: step 25 Phase 1 in wt-step25
steps.detail: Tasks 1.1–1.5; do not touch invoices.cancel (Phase 2, Wave 20). API before web. Starts when all of Wave 16 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged. Gated by 25-P1, P3, P4, P6 and P7.

steps.title: Wave 17: step 26 Phase 1 in wt-step26
steps.detail: Tasks 1.1–1.4 (D1-A, D3-A, D9-A); add no locks in this phase. API first. Starts when all of Wave 16 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged. Gated by 26-P3 before Task 1.2.

steps.title: Gate: run 23-P8 before step 23 Phase 2; 24-P2 before step 24 Task 1.2 ships
steps.detail: 23-P8 (approved bills missing courier/voucher numbers) gates 23 Phase 2 (D4). 24-P2 (generated-shape invoice numbers at or ahead of the counter) gates 24 Task 1.2 shipping; any rows go to accounting.

steps.title: Wave 18: step 20 Phases 2 and 3 in wt-step20 (rebase first)
steps.detail: Phase 2 (Tasks 2.1–2.4, locks only under X29), then Phase 3 (Tasks 3.1–3.2, the no-vendor warning under X32) as a second PR. Starts when Wave 17 is merged; ticked when both PRs are merged.

steps.title: Wave 18: step 21 Phase 1 in wt-step21
steps.detail: Task 1.1 is only withdraw_pending in the J4 set: step 22 Phase 1 already owns createBill (X28). API only. Starts when Wave 17 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged.

steps.title: Wave 18: step 23 Phase 2 in wt-step23 (rebase first)
steps.detail: Tasks 2.1–2.3: touch only BillEditDialog and the update verb's gate list; merges before step 24 Phase 1. API and web together. Starts when Wave 17 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged. Gated by 23-P8.

steps.title: Wave 18: step 24 Phase 1 in wt-step24
steps.detail: Tasks 1.1–1.4: touch only InvoicingDialog; add no locks in this phase. Server first or together. Starts when Wave 17 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged. Gated by 24-P2 before Task 1.2 ships.

steps.title: Wave 18: step 26 Phase 2 in wt-step26 (rebase first)
steps.detail: Tasks 2.1–2.4: payment, then cost lines by (created_at, id), then the bill, in verify and reverse (X30). Server only. Starts when Wave 17 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged.

steps.title: Gate: run 21-P5, P6, P7, 22-P6 and 23-P6, P7 before Wave 19's tasks
steps.detail: 21-P5, 21-P6 and 21-P7 gate 21 Task 2.3 (routine use stops the task for a re-plan of D4/D6); 22-P6 gates 22 Task 2.2 (D5); 23-P6 and 23-P7 gate 23 Phase 3 (D5).

steps.title: Wave 19: step 21 Phase 2 in wt-step21 (rebase first)
steps.detail: Tasks 2.1–2.5: the approved and under-review freeze on saveChildren, computed from step 20's removable (X29). API before web; announce "withdraw before editing a fee". Starts when Wave 18 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged. Gated by 21-P5, P6 and P7.

steps.title: Wave 19: step 22 Phase 2 in wt-step22 (rebase first)
steps.detail: Tasks 2.1–2.3: step 20 has finished with the order fees page; change only the Cost Detail link (X36). Web only. Starts when Wave 18 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged. Gated by 22-P6.

steps.title: Wave 19: step 23 Phase 3 in wt-step23 (rebase first)
steps.detail: Tasks 3.1–3.3 (Task 3.4 is not done under D7-C); lower the indirect-write floor in the same commit (X33). API only. Starts when Wave 18 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged. Gated by 23-P6 and 23-P7.

steps.title: Wave 19: step 24 Phase 2 in wt-step24 (rebase first)
steps.detail: Tasks 2.1–2.3: lock cost lines by (created_at, id), then bills, inside the transaction (X30), with X35's issue-vs-unbill fixture. Server only. Starts when Wave 18 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged.

steps.title: Wave 19: step 26 Phase 3 in wt-step26 (rebase first)
steps.detail: Tasks 3.1–3.6; hand Wilfred the exact expense.payment.update catalog INSERT to run on dev before the Phase 3 proof (X37). Web and API together. Starts when Wave 18 is merged; ticked when its PR is merged.

steps.title: Gate: run 21-P3, 21-P8, P9, 25-P8, P9 and 24-P6 before Wave 20's tasks
steps.detail: 21-P3 gates 21 Task 3.1 (D7); 21-P8 and 21-P9 gate 21 Task 3.2 (D8); 25-P8 and 25-P9 gate 25 Task 2.1 (D6 under X31, D7); 24-P6 comes before the 24 P3 deploy, and accounting is told first.

steps.title: Where the plans and the crosscheck disagree

stages.title: Step 27 · month close
stages.blurb: Waves 22–23 of the step 27 runbook, in two worktrees. D1–D11 all settled A on 2026-09-21; Wave 22 starts when all of Wave 20 and steps 1–3 Wave 1 are merged.

steps.detail: Update feat/new-layout, then create both worktrees when Wave 22 starts (D11 was settled A, so Phase 3 runs). Wave 23 adds no worktree: wt-step27 rebases onto the base that contains 27 P1.

steps.title: Confirm the settled decisions (27 D1–D11)
